author: opencode-worker-4
text: Follow-up fix landed same round (test(schc) commit 4da48ab6ff): the merge had produced TWO same-named definitions of test_validate_full_ipv6_structure_precedes_address_checks in test_headers.py — a merged hybrid (first, shadowed, containing stale pre-ilye 'malformed source' expectations and an orphaned validate_full_ipv6 call) and the ilye.3 canonical definition (second, which Python silently favored). Python does not flag duplicate defs, so 43/43 'passed' while the shadowed body was dead. Removed the shadowed hybrid; tests/schc + test_vectors 2184 green. Lesson for reviewers: same-name duplicate detection matters after cross-worker merges of test files.
